summary: cyberark.pas will be removed from Ansible 15 for repeatedly violating inclusion requirements, but can still be installed with ansible-galaxy afterward.
questions: Is cyberark.pas being removed from the Ansible package?
How do I keep using cyberark.pas after it's removed?

answer_card.title: cyberark.pas removal from Ansible 15
answer_card.answer_md:
The `cyberark.pas` collection will be **removed from Ansible 15** because it repeatedly violated the inclusion requirements and maintainers didn't respond. After removal you can still install it:

```bash
ansible-galaxy collection install cyberark.pas
```
